title: Behind the ‘camaraderie’: How a Manila federation serves Beijing

blocks.text: When you read the articles of incorporation that the Federation of Filipino-Chinese Associations of the Philippines (FFCAP) filed with Philippine authorities, its purpose sounds both noble and harmless: to promote “good relations and camaraderie among Filipino-Chinese associations.” Who could possibly object to that? Read its Chinese-language accounts, however, and a very different picture emerges: that of a deeply ideological entity whose leaders proudly pledge to work under Chinese Embassy guidance while campaigning for Beijing’s political goals — most especially its objective of bringing Taiwan under its rule. Our recent SeaLight Foundation investigation, “Beijing’s ‘Backbone Force’ in Manila,” follows that discrepancy from […]...
